title: Implement hybrid-logical-clock (HLC) timestamp type and ordering
description:
Implement an HLC timestamp type: (wall_time_ms: u64, logical: u32, node_id: [u8; 8]). Implement send() and receive(observed: HlcTimestamp) to advance the clock. Implement Ord so entries can be sorted causally. Artifact: src/hlc.rs in usenet-ipfs-core.

Acceptance:
- send() always returns a timestamp greater than the previous send()
- receive(t) returns max(local+1, t+1) correctly
- Two nodes can merge timestamps without coordination
- Unit test: monotonicity under concurrent sends
- Unit test: receive advances logical counter correctly
